integrity: The proof reduces the three probabilities to fixed-space and centralizer counts in GL_2(F_2), and an exhaustive standalone checker independently evaluates all 576 ordered pairs. The motivating full text was inspected for definitions, Example 6.12, and the published Sylow-local value. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is an exact computation for one order-24 symmetric skew brace, not a classification or a general threshold theorem.
It does not establish a general inequality relating Sylow-local and global brace commuting probabilities.
title: Exact interaction-probability profile of a 24-element symmetric skew brace
